title: A host who knows the prize
hook: Two stated cases: explore the knowledgeable host protocol.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the knowledgeable host protocol affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Switch, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the knowledgeable host protocol in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy prize is uniform over 3 doors. A knowledgeable host always reveals all but one unchosen goat door. What is the win probability if you switch?
